note: Ziira's own message templates. {name} placeholders are the variables, in the order of `variables`. A conversational channel may start a conversation only with an approved template; the same wording is used for SMS and email. Wording lives here, as data, in every language we support.

examples: Sales were up on yesterday and 2 things need attention

en.subject: Your daily brief
en.body: Hello {name}, here is your daily brief for {business}: {summary}

sw.subject: Muhtasari wako wa kila siku
sw.body: Habari {name}, huu ni muhtasari wako wa kila siku wa {business}: {summary}

examples: Cash is short at Thika branch

en.subject: Needs your attention
en.body: Needs your attention at {business}: {summary} Open Ziira to see what to do.

sw.subject: Inahitaji umakini wako
sw.body: Inahitaji umakini wako katika {business}: {summary} Fungua Ziira uone cha kufanya.

en.subject: Payment reminder
en.body: Dear {customer}, invoice {invoice} of {amount} to {business} was due on {due_date}. Please pay at your earliest convenience. If you have already paid, thank you. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Ukumbusho wa malipo
sw.body: Mpendwa {customer}, ankara {invoice} ya {amount} kwa {business} ilikuwa inadaiwa tarehe {due_date}. Tafadhali lipa mapema iwezekanavyo. Kama umeshalipa, asante. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Payment due soon
en.body: Dear {customer}, a friendly reminder: invoice {invoice} of {amount} to {business} is due on {due_date}. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Malipo yanakaribia
sw.body: Mpendwa {customer}, ukumbusho: ankara {invoice} ya {amount} kwa {business} inadaiwa tarehe {due_date}. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

examples: Send Juma a payment reminder about 2 overdue invoices.

en.subject: Approval needed
en.body: {business}: Ziira suggests: {description} It needs your decision.

sw.subject: Idhini inahitajika
sw.body: {business}: Ziira inapendekeza: {description} Linahitaji uamuzi wako.

en.subject: Your verification code
en.body: Your Ziira verification code is {code}. It expires in 15 minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this message.

sw.subject: Msimbo wako wa uthibitisho
sw.body: Msimbo wako wa uthibitisho wa Ziira ni {code}. Unaisha baada ya dakika 15. Kama hukuuomba, puuza ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Your booking is confirmed
en.body: Hello {customer}, your {service} at {business} is booked for {when}. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Miadi yako imethibitishwa
sw.body: Habari {customer}, miadi yako ya {service} katika {business} imewekwa tarehe {when}. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: We have your booking request
en.body: Hello {customer}, we received your request for {service} at {business} on {when}. We will confirm it shortly. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Tumepokea ombi lako la miadi
sw.body: Habari {customer}, tumepokea ombi lako la {service} katika {business} tarehe {when}. Tutakuthibitishia hivi karibuni. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Reminder of your appointment
en.body: Hello {customer}, a reminder of your {service} at {business} on {when}. Please tell us if you cannot come. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Ukumbusho wa miadi yako
sw.body: Habari {customer}, ukumbusho wa miadi yako ya {service} katika {business} tarehe {when}. Tafadhali tuambie usipoweza kuja. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Your appointment was cancelled
en.body: Hello {customer}, your {service} at {business} on {when} has been cancelled. Contact us to book another time. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Miadi yako imeghairiwa
sw.body: Habari {customer}, miadi yako ya {service} katika {business} tarehe {when} imeghairiwa. Wasiliana nasi kupanga wakati mwingine. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: A time has opened up
en.body: Hello {customer}, a time has opened up for {service} at {business} on {when}. Contact us soon to take it. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Nafasi imepatikana
sw.body: Habari {customer}, nafasi imepatikana ya {service} katika {business} tarehe {when}. Wasiliana nasi haraka uichukue. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Your item is ready
en.body: Hello {customer}, your {item} ({job}) is ready for collection at {business}. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Kitu chako kiko tayari
sw.body: Habari {customer}, {item} yako ({job}) iko tayari kuchukuliwa katika {business}. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Your estimate is ready
en.body: Hello {customer}, the estimate for your {item} ({job}) at {business} is ready. See it and answer here: {link} Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Makadirio yako yako tayari
sw.body: Habari {customer}, makadirio ya {item} yako ({job}) katika {business} yako tayari. Yaone na ujibu hapa: {link} Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: More work found on your vehicle
en.body: Hello {customer}, more work was found on your {item} ({job}) at {business}. See what is needed and approve or decline here: {link} Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Kazi zaidi imepatikana
sw.body: Habari {customer}, kazi zaidi imepatikana kwenye {item} yako ({job}) katika {business}. Ona kinachohitajika na uidhinishe au ukatae hapa: {link} Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Service due
en.body: Hello {customer}, your {item} is due for service on {when}. Call {business} to book it in. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Huduma inakaribia
sw.body: Habari {customer}, {item} yako inastahili huduma tarehe {when}. Piga simu {business} kuweka nafasi. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Please collect your item
en.body: Hello {customer}, your {item} ({job}) has been ready at {business} for some days. Please collect it soon. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Tafadhali chukua kitu chako
sw.body: Habari {customer}, {item} yako ({job}) imekuwa tayari katika {business} kwa siku kadhaa. Tafadhali ichukue hivi karibuni. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Estimate for your claim
en.body: Hello {payer}, {business} sent an estimate for {item} ({claim}). Open it, answer each line and sign off here: {link} Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Makadirio ya dai lako
sw.body: Habari {payer}, {business} imetuma makadirio ya {item} ({claim}). Yafungue, jibu kila mstari na utie sahihi hapa: {link} Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Your membership renews soon
en.body: Dear {customer}, your {plan} membership at {business} renews on {date} for {amount}. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Uanachama wako unaisha hivi karibuni
sw.body: Mpendwa {customer}, uanachama wako wa {plan} katika {business} utarejeshwa tarehe {date} kwa {amount}. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Your package expires soon
en.body: Dear {customer}, you still have {credits} left on your {package} at {business}. It expires on {date}, so please book before then. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Kifurushi chako kinakaribia kuisha
sw.body: Mpendwa {customer}, bado una {credits} kwenye {package} yako katika {business}. Kinaisha tarehe {date}, tafadhali weka nafasi kabla ya hapo. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Time not logged
en.body: {business}: Hello {name}, you have {logged} h logged for {date} (the usual minimum is {wanted} h). Please add your time.

sw.subject: Muda haujaandikwa
sw.body: {business}: Habari {name}, umeandika saa {logged} kwa {date} (kiwango cha kawaida ni saa {wanted}). Tafadhali ongeza muda wako.

en.subject: Send in your week
en.body: {business}: Hello {name}, your week of {week} ({hours} h) is not sent in yet. Please submit it so it can be approved and billed.

sw.subject: Tuma wiki yako
sw.body: {business}: Habari {name}, wiki yako ya {week} (saa {hours}) bado haijatumwa. Tafadhali itume ili iidhinishwe na kutozwa.

en.subject: Timesheet waiting for you
en.body: {business}: Hello {name}, {person}'s week of {week} ({hours} h) has been waiting {days} days for approval.

sw.subject: Ratiba ya muda inakusubiri
sw.body: {business}: Habari {name}, wiki ya {person} ya {week} (saa {hours}) imesubiri idhini kwa siku {days}.

en.subject: Invoice to review
en.body: {business}: Hello {name}, an invoice for {client} ({amount}) is waiting for your review before it goes out.

sw.subject: Ankara ya kukagua
sw.body: {business}: Habari {name}, ankara ya {client} ({amount}) inasubiri ukaguzi wako kabla ya kutumwa.

examples: Please check the hours on the audit.

en.subject: Invoice sent back
en.body: {business}: Hello {name}, the invoice for {client} was sent back for changes: {note}

sw.subject: Ankara imerudishwa
sw.body: {business}: Habari {name}, ankara ya {client} imerudishwa ifanyiwe marekebisho: {note}

en.subject: Work due soon
en.body: {business}: Hello {name}, {task} for {client} is due on {date}.

sw.subject: Kazi inakaribia tarehe
sw.body: {business}: Habari {name}, {task} ya {client} inatakiwa kufikia {date}.

en.subject: Your place is booked
en.body: Hello {customer}, your place in {service} at {business} on {when} is booked. Tell us early if you cannot come. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Nafasi yako imehifadhiwa
sw.body: Habari {customer}, nafasi yako katika {service} katika {business} tarehe {when} imehifadhiwa. Tuambie mapema usipoweza kuja. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: A place is free for you
en.body: Hello {customer}, a place has come free in {service} at {business} on {when}. It is held for you until {until}: reply or call us to take it. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Nafasi imepatikana kwa ajili yako
sw.body: Habari {customer}, nafasi imepatikana katika {service} katika {business} tarehe {when}. Imeshikiliwa kwa ajili yako hadi {until}: jibu au tupigie ili uichukue. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Class cancelled
en.body: Hello {customer}, we are sorry: {service} at {business} on {when} has been cancelled. Please contact us to book another time.

sw.subject: Darasa limeghairiwa
sw.body: Habari {customer}, samahani: {service} katika {business} tarehe {when} limeghairiwa. Tafadhali wasiliana nasi ili upange wakati mwingine.

en.subject: School fees due
en.body: Dear {customer}, the fees for {learner} at {business} ({amount}) are due on {date}. Please pay on or before that date, or speak to us if you need to agree another date. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Ada ya shule inakaribia
sw.body: Mpendwa {customer}, ada ya {learner} katika {business} ({amount}) inapaswa kulipwa tarehe {date}. Tafadhali lipa kabla ya tarehe hiyo, au zungumza nasi ukihitaji kukubaliana tarehe nyingine. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Absent from class
en.body: Dear {customer}, {learner} was marked absent from {service} at {business} on {when}. Please let us know if something is wrong; we can arrange a make-up session. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Hakuhudhuria darasa
sw.body: Mpendwa {customer}, {learner} alikosa {service} katika {business} tarehe {when}. Tafadhali tujulishe kama kuna tatizo; tunaweza kupanga kipindi cha kufidia. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: End of term
en.body: Dear {customer}, the term for {learner} at {business} ends on {date}. Please check that all fees are paid, and tell us if {learner} will continue next term. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Mwisho wa muhula
sw.body: Mpendwa {customer}, muhula wa {learner} katika {business} unaisha tarehe {date}. Tafadhali hakikisha ada zote zimelipwa, na utujulishe kama {learner} ataendelea muhula ujao. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Time for your next visit
en.body: Hello {customer}, it is time for your next {service} at {business}. Reply or call us to book a time. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Ni wakati wa ziara yako ijayo
sw.body: Habari {customer}, ni wakati wa {service} yako ijayo katika {business}. Jibu au tupigie ili upange wakati. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Your next visit is due
en.body: Hello {customer}, your next {service} at {business} is due. Please call us to book an appointment. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Ziara yako ijayo inakaribia
sw.body: Habari {customer}, {service} yako ijayo katika {business} inatakiwa. Tafadhali tupigie ili upange miadi. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Thank you for visiting
en.body: Hello {customer}, thank you for your {service} at {business}. Would you like to book your next visit? Reply or call us. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Asante kwa kutembelea
sw.body: Habari {customer}, asante kwa {service} yako katika {business}. Ungependa kupanga ziara yako ijayo? Jibu au tupigie. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Book your next appointment
en.body: Hello {customer}, thank you for visiting {business}. If you need a follow-up visit, please call us to book it. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Panga miadi yako ijayo
sw.body: Habari {customer}, asante kwa kutembelea {business}. Ukihitaji ziara ya ufuatiliaji, tafadhali tupigie ili upange. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Reminder of your appointment
en.body: Hello {customer}, a reminder of your {service} appointment at {business} on {when}. If you are using an insurer or scheme, please bring your card. Please tell us if you cannot come. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Ukumbusho wa miadi yako
sw.body: Habari {customer}, ukumbusho wa miadi yako ya {service} katika {business} tarehe {when}. Ukitumia bima, tafadhali lete kadi yako. Tafadhali tuambie usipoweza kuja. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Deposit for your booking
en.body: Hello {customer}, your {service} at {business} on {when} needs a deposit of {amount}. {how} Your time is held once it is paid. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Amana ya miadi yako
sw.body: Habari {customer}, {service} yako katika {business} tarehe {when} inahitaji amana ya {amount}. {how} Muda wako utashikiliwa ukishalipwa. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Your payment is late
en.body: Dear {customer}, {amount} for invoice {invoice} at {business} was due on {date} and is still unpaid. Please pay as soon as you can so your membership is not interrupted. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Malipo yako yamechelewa
sw.body: Mpendwa {customer}, {amount} ya ankara {invoice} katika {business} ilipaswa kulipwa tarehe {date} na bado haijalipwa. Tafadhali lipa mapema ili uanachama wako usikatizwe. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Your membership is on hold
en.body: Dear {customer}, your membership at {business} is on hold because {amount} is unpaid. Pay at the front desk and it opens again at once. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Uanachama wako umesitishwa
sw.body: Mpendwa {customer}, uanachama wako katika {business} umesitishwa kwa sababu {amount} haijalipwa. Lipa mapokezini na utafunguliwa mara moja. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: We miss you
en.body: Hello {customer}, we have not seen you at {business} for {weeks} weeks. Come back this week: we are glad to help you restart. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Tunakukumbuka
sw.body: Habari {customer}, hatujakuona katika {business} kwa wiki {weeks}. Rudi wiki hii: tutafurahi kukusaidia kuanza tena. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Happy birthday
en.body: Happy birthday {customer}! From everyone at {business}. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Heri ya siku ya kuzaliwa
sw.body: Heri ya siku ya kuzaliwa {customer}! Kutoka kwetu sote katika {business}. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: How was your trial?
en.body: Hello {customer}, thank you for trying {business}. If you would like to join, ask at the front desk and we will set you up today. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Majaribio yalikuwaje?
sw.body: Habari {customer}, asante kwa kujaribu {business}. Ukipenda kujiunga, uliza mapokezini na tutakusajili leo. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Time to restock?
en.body: Hello {customer}, this is a reminder from {business}: your usual purchase may be due for a refill. Call or visit us when you need it. You asked for these reminders. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Ni wakati wa kuongeza?
sw.body: Habari {customer}, huu ni ukumbusho kutoka {business}: ununuzi wako wa kawaida unaweza kuwa unahitaji kuongezwa. Tupigie au tembelea unapohitaji. Uliomba ukumbusho huu. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.

en.subject: Your order is ready
en.body: Hello {customer}, your order is ready for collection at {business}. Reply STOP to stop these messages.

sw.subject: Oda yako iko tayari
sw.body: Habari {customer}, oda yako iko tayari kuchukuliwa katika {business}. Jibu ACHA kuacha ujumbe huu.
